Chapter 319: Chapter 16: Obtaining The Treasure (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 319: Chapter 16: Obtaining the Treasure (Please Subscribe)_2

It was because of this,

that the three goddesses had entrusted decision-making power to higher-level citizens.

It was also one of the ‘hidden benefits’ belonging to higher-level citizens.

…

Next,

Shi Feng brought over seven or eight Evolvers.

...

They were representatives from various star domains of the Annan Star Alliance.

These Evolvers were quite courteous to Lin Yuan, as powerful star domains like the Golden Dragon Star Domain were rare.

Furthermore, with proud individuals such as Jin Tianzhao, such people were even rarer.

Generally speaking, everyone was quite polite to Sixth-Level Citizens, even if their negotiations did not succeed, there would be no threats.

Because there was no point in it.

…

“How about it?”

“Have you made your choice?”

Shi Feng looked at Lin Yuan with interest.

He had already reached an agreement with a certain star domain.

The offer from that star domain also satisfied Shi Feng.

Now, he was mainly curious about Lin Yuan’s choice.

“Let’s go with Wangyue Starfield.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and then spoke.

The representatives from the other seven or eight star domains had conditions that matched those of Wangyue Starfield.

Logically speaking, Lin Yuan’s choice of any one of them would have been similar.

However, Lin Yuan did possess the legacy of Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

And Wangyue Starfield was Ou Yin’s home star domain.

In such a situation, with conditions being equal, Lin Yuan naturally leaned towards Wangyue Starfield.

“Good.”

Shi Feng nodded.

He immediately contacted the young man ‘Na Dan’ from Wangyue Starfield.

A moment later,

The young man ‘Na Dan’ appeared in the personal space.

“Thank you, Mr. Shisan, for your assistance. I represent Wangyue Starfield, and we are immensely grateful.”

The young man ‘Na Dan’ spoke with a slightly respectful tone, his offer was no different from several others, and Lin Yuan choosing him naturally warranted thanks.

“We each take what we need.”

Lin Yuan waved his hand and said casually.

He was not helping Wangyue Starfield for nothing.

“This is the password for Shuntong Group’s ‘safebox’. Mr. Shisan only needs to log onto the Shuntong Group website, enter the ‘safebox’ service, and then he can access the reward.”

The young man ‘Na Dan’ sent Lin Yuan a string of numbers.

Shuntong Group, being the largest transport group in the Human Civilization Alliance, took privacy very seriously in their safebox service.

The young man ‘Na Dan’ placed the treasure in a safebox of the Shuntong Group and then handed over the password to Lin Yuan.

With the password, Lin Yuan could claim ownership of the rewards in the safebox, and then just have Shuntong Group deliver it.

The entire process was such that neither party knew the other’s location, the delivery location, and so on.

In this respect, with Human Civilization’s assurance, it was absolutely trustworthy, even Chikun Star Lords like Eighth Layer invincible beings used the transport services of Shuntong Group.

“Good.”

Lin Yuan wrote down the password and nodded.

“Shisan, about that Soul Defense Treasure, if you ever decide not to keep it, you must tell me. I will buy it for the highest price…”

Shi Feng immediately said.

He was also very eager to have that Soul Defense Treasure, but alas, compared to another treasure, Shi Feng still chose the latter.

“Certainly.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure was only for transition.

Once Lin Yuan stepped into the Eighth Rank, or repaired that Eighth-Rank Soul Defense Treasure, he naturally wouldn’t need this Seventh-Rank Soul Defense Treasure.

“Ah… Every time the Star Alliance assembly convenes, we Sixth-Level Citizens, have only voting rights. As for actual decision-making, it’s still those ‘councilors’…”

Shi Feng said with a sigh.

The prerequisite for being a councilor in the Annan Star Alliance is being a Seventh-Level Citizen. Although the difference is only one level between a Sixth and Seventh-Level Citizen, in terms of status and privileges, it’s a qualitative change.

Not a single Sixth-Level Citizen does not yearn to become a Seventh-Level Citizen, but mere yearning is useless.

It also requires a tremendous amount of Merit Points to meet the requirements for promotion to a Seventh-Level Citizen.

“Seventh-Level Citizen…”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly serious.

For a Sixth-Level Citizen to be promoted to a Seventh-Level Citizen, two million Merit Points are needed, akin to killing two Eighth Rank aliens on the Battlefields of Different Species.

The most crucial thing is, killing these two Eighth Rank aliens must be done by the original body, avatar kills wouldn’t possibly yield a million Merit Points.

That is, only by completely killing two Eighth Rank aliens can one gain two million Merit Points.

This is too difficult.

Chikun Star Lord had dominated the battlefields of different races, swallowing countless eighth rank aliens in the guise of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun.

However, most of those eighth rank aliens were merely avatars. As for their true forms, they had long been hiding somewhere unknown.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan stepped out of the grand hall.

Shortly after.

A spaceship landed.

From inside, a fiercely gazing staff member exited.

“Here are the items for your shipment. Please sign for them.”

This staff member, possessing at least the power of the Seventh Rank, was a high-star employee of Shuntong Group, specifically responsible for the transport of valuable items.

“Good.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The payment from ‘Na Dan’, a young man from the Wangyue Starfield, was transported through Shuntong Group.

With the service standard of the safe deposit box business, it was quickly delivered.

Drip—

Lin Yuan confirmed his identity and smoothly accepted it.

“Serving you is an honor for us at Shuntong.”

The fiercely gazing staff member gave a slight bow to Lin Yuan and then returned to the spaceship.

…..

In the depths of the grand hall.

Lin Yuan began to examine the treasures.

The first was that seventh-rank soul defense treasure.

It was a palm-sized jade pendant, exhibiting a faint pink color.

After Lin Yuan refined it, the jade pendant transformed into flowing light, entered his sea of consciousness, and guarded his soul.

“Not bad.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Although he was deep in Chikun Main Star, where he presumably wouldn’t encounter any dangers,

having such a treasure was better than none, especially since this soul defense treasure was not purchased by Lin Yuan himself; it was an unexpected gain.

“Jianmu fragment…”

Lin Yuan took out the second treasure.

It was a piece of tree fragment, its surface subtly charred black.

Merely by looking at it, Lin Yuan felt, deep in the cosmic starry skies, a colossal divine tree supporting the heavens and the earth was slightly swaying.

“Is that Jianmu?”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes and felt slightly amazed in his heart.

Jianmu was a dominator-level powerhouse deep in the cosmos, belonging to plant life.

Its mere size spanned beyond ten light-years, indeed a colossal entity. Even the Chikun Star Lord dared not approach the true form of Jianmu.

As for this fragment of Jianmu, it came from a thunder tribulation that Jianmu underwent every hundred thousand years, fragments that were shattered during the tribulation.

“Heavenly Azure Water.”

Lin Yuan turned to the third treasure.

This water could purify impurities in the flesh and solidify the origin of the flesh, useful for any evolver.

“Let’s try it.”

Lin Yuan absorbed a drop of ‘Heavenly Azure Water’; immediately, he felt a special power begin to spread to his limbs.

“Truly marvelous…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, as he keenly felt its effects.

…

Golden Dragon Star Domain.

On a pure gold-colored planet.

Jin Tianzhao, dressed in a golden robe, hesitated for a moment before deciding to see his teacher.

“Tianzhao, what is it?”

The Golden Dragon Star Master’s eyes shone gold, his presence majestic, as if transcending the cosmic starry skies.

“Teacher.”

“A few days ago, due to the matters of the Star Alliance conference, I threatened a Seventh-Level Citizen who supported the Wangyue Starfield a few times… ”

Jin Tianzhao spoke truthfully.

If Lin Yuan were just an ordinary Seventh-Level Citizen, he wouldn’t care much.

But that comment from Shi Feng, about Lin Yuan’s true age possibly being less than a thousand years,

had unsettled Jin Tianzhao. A Seventh-Level Citizen under a thousand years old possessed not insignificant potential, and he must inform his teacher.

“The one known as ‘Shisan’, that Seventh-Level Citizen?”

The Golden Dragon Star Master looked down at Jin Tianzhao, almost without needing to think, he could deduce that ‘Shisan’ was an alias.

The true identity of that Seventh-Level Citizen, apart from three goddesses, probably nobody knew.

“Don’t worry.”

The Golden Dragon Star Master spoke calmly, “Even if he can become an Eighth Layer Citizen, that will be a matter for the distant future; for now, focus on the current matters.”
